## E — Market signal: drinking, drugs and health
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NJ-DUI-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: parents of teen drivers often worry about underage drinking and driving, which suggests a zero-tolerance explainer angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: New Jersey learner demand, pass rates, pricing, voice-of-customer quotes and ad hooks for the drinking, drugs and health topic are unresearched.
